items: Insert No. 3 shift fork shaft through No. 3 shift fork and the reverse shift arm.

Align No. 3 shift fork with the No. 3 hub sleeve groove. Put the reverse shift arm into the pivot of bearing retainer and align the reverse shift arm shoe with the reverse idler gear groove. Install No. 3 shift fork shaft to the intermediate plate.

content.description: Illustration showing the installation of No. 3 shift fork shaft through the shift fork and reverse shift arm into the transmission assembly

items: Push the pin, which was inserted into the reverse shift arm hole, into the groove of No. 3 shift fork shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing pushing the pin from the reverse shift arm hole into the groove of No. 3 shift fork shaft

items: Install No. 4 shift fork shaft to the intermediate plate over the reverse shift arm.

content.description: Illustration showing the installation of No. 4 shift fork shaft to the intermediate plate over the reverse shift arm

content.text: (d) Using a pin punch, drive in the slotted spring pin until it is flush with the fork.

content.description: Illustration showing using a pin punch to drive in the slotted spring pin until it is flush with the fork

content.text: (e) Apply MP grease to No. 3 interlock pin and install the pin into the intermediate plate hole.

content.description: Illustration showing applying MP grease to No. 3 interlock pin and installing the pin into the intermediate plate hole
